notes: Delete this row - example only. One row per SKU. Shopify: sku is the Variant SKU and listing_id (optional) the product handle. fulfillment_per_unit_usd is pick, pack and postage per unit, or your 3PL's per-unit fee. Lead time = PO placed to your shelf or 3PL. Leave any column blank and that cost is not counted, never guessed.

Delete this row - example only. Amazon: sku is your seller SKU and listing_id (optional) the ASIN. Leave fulfillment_per_unit_usd blank for FBA: Amazon's fulfilment fee is already in your SKU Economics export. Selling one SKU on both? Fill it in for your own shipping or 3PL: it counts on Shopify orders and on Amazon orders Amazon did not fulfil, never on top of an FBA fee. A product with a different SKU on each platform gets a row for each. Lead time = PO placed to FBA check-in. The supplier columns are optional: minimum order, case pack, the quantity at which the unit price drops and the price there, and the air option (freight per unit, lead time in days) against the sea freight in inbound_freight_per_unit_usd.
